about_the_game:
Embark on a perilous journey through the frozen wilderness of the Canadian Arctic in Artic Roll, a turn-based tactical roguelike adventure.

Lead a team of three brave explorers as you roll the dice to determine your path, survive deadly encounters, and uncover the mystery behind a strange signal emerging from the melting permafrost. Every expedition is different thanks to procedurally generated maps, challenging survival mechanics, and the constant threat of the unknown.

In Artic Roll, strategy, resource management, and a bit of luck will determine whether you make it back alive or vanish into the endless snow.

KEY FEATURES

  • Turn-based tactical gameplay – Plan each move carefully as every roll of the dice can change your fate.

  • Procedurally generated expeditions – No two journeys are the same.

  • Survival elements – Manage resources, heal your team, and adapt to harsh conditions.

  • Mysterious narrative – Follow clues to uncover the source of a strange signal deep in the Arctic.

  • Challenging encounters – Face unpredictable wildlife and environmental hazards.
